{"metadata":{"description":"Cross-session long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)","id":"gh:1334000679","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-agent-memory","slug":"Culeot/dsh-agent-memory","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","memory"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Cross-session long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-agent-memory"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Cross-session long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文文档"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Remembers facts, preferences, decisions, and lessons across sessions, so a new session starts with w"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"hat earlier sessions already learned. Storage lives in `$DSH_HOME/storages/memory.json` (plain JSON "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"— inspectable, git-friendly). No MCP servers, no vector database, no embedding API, no extra runtime"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" git-friendly). No MCP servers, no vector database, no embedding API, no extra runtime dependencies."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Cross-session persistence** — write in session A, recall in session B; new sessions pick up wher"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"e old ones left off.
- **Relevance-threshold injection** — before each model step, the plugin recall"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"s memories matching the user's current message, **filters by minimum relevance score** (`injectMinSc"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ore`), and injects up to `injectCount` that pass the threshold. Low-relevance memories are discarded"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" — you only pay for what actually matters.
- **Multi-dimensional relevance** — scoring combines sema"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ntic similarity, task relevance, pattern matching, causal linkage, and recency (not just keyword ove"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"rlap). A memory is used when ≥2 dimensions match, reducing noise from coincidental keyword hits.
- *"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"*Anti-decay rules** — the protocol section includes self-reinforcing rules: task-start recall re-rea"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ds core rules, recurring mistakes auto-solidify as lessons, and language drift triggers self-correct"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ion.
- **Self-correction loop** — when the same error (same code/message) fires repeatedly (`lessoni"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"zeAfter`, default 2), the plugin nudges the agent to write it as an importance-3 lesson; the lesson "},{"id":"p8s12","text":"then auto-injects on related topics, preventing recurrence. User corrections are covered by the memo"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"ry protocol (write the lesson right away).
- **Built-in hygiene** — capacity cap with lowest-value e"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"viction first; near-duplicate entries merge instead of piling up (Jaccard ≥ 0.7); optional TTL expir"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"y; deleting importance-3 records requires an explicit confirm.
- **Chinese-friendly search** — Chine"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"se text is indexed by bigrams plus single-char fallback plus a BM25 term-frequency signal, English b"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"y words, plus exact substring matching. Works without a tokenizer or any ML dependency.
- **No unrel"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"ated association** — weak matches (pure single-char coincidence, filler-only queries like "ok了吗") sc"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"ore zero and are never injected; only substring/tag/bigram-strength matches surface. Saves tokens on"},{"id":"p8s20","text":" short chatter.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| `memory_remember` | Store a durable memory (content, kind, tags, scope, importance, optional TTL)."},{"id":"p11s2","text":" |
| `memory_recall` | Search memory by keywords; ranks by relevance, importance, recency, past usag"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"e. |
| `memory_index` | Browse the inventory with kind/tag/scope filters, paginated, title-level. |
"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"| `memory_forget` | Delete by id or tags; importance-3 records need `confirm: true`. |
| `memory_imp"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ort` | Import memories from a JSONL/JSON file through the write chain (not by editing the store file"},{"id":"p11s6","text":") — safe bulk loading. |
| `memory_reload` | Reopen the store from disk after an external edit; merg"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"es external changes without a restart. |
| `memory_sediment` | Batch-persist several memories at onc"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"e (session wind-down), with an entry cap and cooldown guard. |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Kinds: `fact | preference | decision | lesson | todo | note`. Scopes: `user` (applies everywhere) or"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" `project` (this project only)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Semantic retrieval (optional) — you train the model yourself"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**No model file ships with this plugin.** Lexical scoring on its own is complete and needs nothing e"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"lse; the semantic channel is a second opinion you can add later."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"It is worth adding, but not for the reason you'd expect. On a 382-query held-out set built from a re"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ing, but not for the reason you'd expect. On a 382-query held-out set built from a real memory bank:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Channel | MRR | Recall@1 |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| lexical only | 0.7248 | 63.4% |
| semantic only | 0.7121 | 61.3% |
| **both, fused** | **0.8432** "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"y | 0.7248 | 63.4% |
| semantic only | 0.7121 | 61.3% |
| **both, fused** | **0.8432** | **76.4%** |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Read the middle row again: semantic **alone loses** to lexical. No single model you could download m"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"akes retrieval better by itself. The gain comes from fusing two channels that fail in *different* pl"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"aces — lexical owns exact terms, paths and command names; semantic owns paraphrase."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Why no model is bundled"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Size** — 393 MB base model + 391 MB trained + 486 MB quantized ONNX. That is not something to pu"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"t in an npm package.
- **It would be the wrong model anyway** — a retriever learns what *your* queri"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"es and *your* memories look like. Ours are Chinese technical notes queried as keyword stacks (`语音插件 "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"语音播报 speak tts`). Yours almost certainly differ, and a mismatched retriever is a silent downgrade.
-"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" **Optional means optional** — a missing `@huggingface/transformers`, a missing model directory, or "},{"id":"p20s6","text":"a failed vector computation all degrade quietly to lexical scoring and record why. A memory plugin t"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"hat refuses to start because an optional accelerator is misconfigured would be worse than having no "},{"id":"p20s8","text":"t because an optional accelerator is misconfigured would be worse than having no accelerator at all."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Full walkthrough"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"See **`training/README.md`** — environment setup, downloading the base model, held-out splitting, tw"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"o-track training-pair generation, contrastive training, ONNX export with a correctness check, and wi"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ring the result into the plugin."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The short version:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Then, in your profile: `pnpm add @huggingface/transformers`, point `semanticModelDir` at `work/model"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"-onnx`, restart DSH."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"All six scripts in `training/` take their paths from environment variables (`MEM_TRAIN_WORK`, `MEM_T"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"RAIN_MEMORY`, `MEM_TRAIN_BASE`, `MEM_TRAIN_LLM`), so they run from any directory. An NVIDIA GPU help"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"s (RTX 4080 Laptop 12 GB: ~2.4 min for 306 memories × 30 epochs) but CPU works — just slower. Budget"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"top 12 GB: ~2.4 min for 306 memories × 30 epochs) but CPU works — just slower. Budget ~2 GB of disk."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## External-modification protection"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The store file is loaded once at startup and written as a whole by the running process (single-write"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"r model). To prevent an in-process write from silently wiping external edits:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- every write checks the file fingerprint first — a mismatch (another process or a script edited it)"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" **refuses the write** with a clear error instead of overwriting;
- `memory_import` is the supported"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" way to bulk-load data (goes through the write chain, file and memory stay in sync);
